column1: If Copilot lacks database-specific context, first check for an active {{c1::database connection}}.
column2:
The connected account also needs permission to read the required schema information.

column1: For a SQL database in the Fabric portal, access Copilot from the {{c1::query editor}}.
column2:
Open the database and use the Copilot button or chat interface.

column1: Copilot in Fabric SQL database requires supported paid capacity rather than {{c1::trial capacity}}.
column2:
Use F2 or higher, or P1 or higher, in a supported region with the required Copilot tenant settings enabled.
